_doc: WT64v1 single machine-readable ISA source (v1.8.0a COMMIT 1, spec §23.9). Edit THIS file, run scripts/gen_isa_tables.py generate, commit source + generated artifacts together. asm_legality and rtl_legality are DELIBERATELY separate: two documented asymmetries are preserved emitter-faithfully (asm skips required-port under allow_imm_xor_opref; asm fine-grained imm forbids vs RTL collapsed forbid_imm_any; RTL is_alu_binary excludes 0x63/64/65). Unification is an explicit v1.8.0b decision — do not silently "fix" one emitter. Optional per-opcode bit decode_reserved (v1.8.0e 3a-C2, spec §27.7a.4): the row is transcribed (legality shape + fp_block mode ROM + asm mnemonic) but the opcode is OMITTED from the generated opcode_supported whitelist, so the RTL keeps decode_erroring it until its execute wiring lands — the spec-pinned staging state for an opcode whose ISA row must ship BEFORE its PE_Core arm. This creates a THIRD documented asymmetry while it is set: asm-legal is NOT a subset of RTL-legal for such an opcode (the assembler accepts its legal modes; the RTL decode_errors every mode). It resolves when the bit is cleared and the tables are regenerated. Mutually exclusive with stub_v18 (decode-legal capability absence): a decode_reserved op is not decode-legal at all.

opcodes.notes: v1.6.5c §22.16.0 bugfix preserved: IMM64/OPREF EHs are LEGAL here even though the RTL data path reads only input_payload_b — the EH carries the SDK static-schedule origin. RTL is_alu_binary EXCLUDES 0x63/64/65 (no XOR check) while asm enforces imm64-XOR-opref: documented asymmetry, asm-legal is a subset of RTL-legal.
PRECISION EH (dim_ovr) expected for tag-stability (§22.16.3) — precision is not a data EH, so forbid flags do not affect it.

opcodes.desc: GAMMA_MUL_W — MU-hosted exact widening per-lane int4 x int4 -> int8: A = 16 int4 lanes (64b single-fragment payload_a), gamma = 16 int4 lanes via IMM64 XOR OPREF; out[i] = sext8(a4[i]) * sext8(g4[i]) at bits [8i+7:8i] (lane order pinned spec+golden+SDK), 128b out = 2 fragments; gamma carries an implicit 2^-k folded into the DEQUANT broadcast scale as an exact exponent shift
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0e 0e1 IMPLEMENTED (spec section 25.2.3): pre-stable REALLOCATION of the retired 0x6B code point (section 12a rule 4 — reserved-return encoding reuse, slot reuse explicitly recorded here; the mandatory retired-0x6B stale-consumer grep ran at this commit: the 0x66/67/6B/6C removal regression pins and the frozen truth-table domain_version were resynced with it). Exists to repair the fatal broadcast-gamma refutation: s_c = s*gamma_c cannot implement the documented per-lane gamma contract, and 0x6B makes criterion 3 genuinely met end-to-end for RMSNORM. EXACT: int4 products lie in [-56, +64], inside int8 — rounding-free and saturation-free. Combinational 1-cycle MU arm inside the parameter-gated region (16 L-PEs synthesize nothing); multipliers built LUT-structural (shift-add, no DSP inference); 2-fragment emit via the widened frag FSM. alu-binary XOR satisfied by exactly one of {IMM*, OPREF} (both/neither = alu_binary_xor_err at EHDecode); asm canonical form is IMM64 (imm16/imm32 zero-extend through eff_b_value — upper gamma lanes 0, RTL-tolerated). MU routing rides the twin-classifier lockstep edit (Cluster.v is_mul_op + PE_Core.v dec_is_mul_op, spec section 25.3) landing with the 0e1 integration commit.

opcodes.desc: VFMA_ACC — STATELESS per-lane int32 wrap FMA: out[i] = (sext32(a[i]) * b_mul + c_acc) mod 2^32 at bits [32i+31:32i] (2 int32 lanes/word); A = 128b wide (2-frag wave): dtype 0x0 = 32 int4 lanes -> 16 fragments (the frag-widening + Cluster mask-fix consumer), 0x1 = 16 int8 lanes -> 8 fragments; B 64b split {c_acc = B[63:32] broadcast int32 addend, b_mul = sext32(B[3:0]) int4 / sext32(B[7:0]) int8} via IMM-XOR-OPREF; acc=1 marks the wide-acc OUTPUT form, NOT stateful accumulation (fp dtypes + stateful accumulator are v2.0)
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0e 0e2 IMPLEMENTED (spec section 25.2.4): stub_v18 dropped with the 0x70 launch arm in the same commit (stub set is now {0x7D, 0x7E}). Decode legality UNCHANGED from the v1.8.0a COMMIT 2 skeleton — the EH row and the mode-byte ROM row (legal_dtypes [0,1], acc [1], rnd [0]) ship as-pinned; the stub drop touches no generated decode table except the STUB_OPS_V18 python set (truth-table domain excludes 0x70-0x7F — zero recapture). STATELESS pin: acc=1 is the wide-acc OUTPUT-form marker (the lane-engine polarity misread is corrected on record); c_acc can sit exactly at the wrap boundary — mod 2^32 is EXPLICIT and golden-pinned (ref_vfma_lane). B split: imm16/imm32 zero-fill the upper word -> c_acc = 0; the datapath reads ONLY B[3:0] (int4) / B[7:0] (int8) for b_mul — asm-lint LOUDLY rejects imm encodings with nonzero low-word bits above the lane width (pack_vfma_b helper; no silent truncation is observable from legal programs). Compute: ONE shared sequential LUT-mapped signed 8x8 MAC step (fp_comb_arms.vh vfma_mac_lane32, shift-add LUT-structural — the section 25.5.1 DSP-suppression mechanism, 0 new MULT18), 1 cy/lane, launch-cycle capture of A(128b)+B-split+tag into MU-local regs (0x74 idiom); never FP_StepSeq. Emit: lane pairs pack 2 int32/word — word 0 -> frag0_hold, words >= 1 -> frag_pending[1..15]; fragment 0 emits at LOOP COMPLETION (section 25.6 item 8 invariant) then rows drain 1/cycle through the widened FSM — the int4 form is the FIRST 16-fragment emitter (tot_m1 = 15, the Cluster frag_mask_full 5-bit-shift fix consumer). Occupancy: vfma_busy joins output_regs_free (10th term) AND the 0x12 MUL launch gate; mid-flight mul-class dispatches busy-reject loudly (lower_required, VDOT rung). Cycle ceilings (section 25.4): int4 90, int8 48. instruction+EH chain replicated on every fragment (VDOT contract). MU routing rides the twin-classifier lockstep edit (Cluster.v is_mul_op + PE_Core.v dec_is_mul_op += 0x70) landing with this 0e2 commit.

opcodes.desc: VDOT_ACC — stateless 4-fragment wide dot: A=wide[127:0], B=wide[255:128] (SIG_BMM_3 pattern); dtype 0x0=32 int4 lanes, 0x1=16 int8 lanes; r=(sext64(dot)+carry_in) mod 2^64 emitted immediately (full 64-bit payload); carry-in via IMM-XOR-OPREF (asm default IMM16=0); MU-hosted (twin classifier)
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0b IMPLEMENTED (stateless-dot-first, workflow wwov1b5i3). NO accumulator state — K-loops chain via serial carry-in or VDOT partials + ADD 0x10 trees; low-32 of any chain == numpy int32 wrap (IMMA channel). SDK contract: exactly 4 fragments, instruction+EH chain replicated on every fragment.

opcodes.desc: ACC_REDUCE — stateless reduction over wide[127:0]: sub-op imm16[7:4] per acc_reduce_op_codes (absent imm16 = SUM); imm16[3:0] reserved-zero else lower_required; MEAN=RNE(sum/N) ties-to-even, full lane set only; emits sext64(int32); MU-hosted
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0b IMPLEMENTED. Monotonic loosening: imm16 forbidden->optional (absent=SUM keeps every previously-legal encoding decoding). MIN deliberately NOT shipped (RED=2 vs einsum=6 namespace collision dodged). imm32/imm64 stay asm-forbidden but are RTL-tolerated (eff_imm16=0 => SUM) — documented reserved.

opcodes.desc: ACC_ELEMWISE — round-once fp32 FMA a*B[63:32]+B[31:0], OPREF form ONLY (B via dec_eff_b_value); any imm present -> lower_required; MU-hosted
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0d IMPLEMENTED (integration commit, spec section 23.10.10(c)): OPREF-form-only graduation — stub_v18 dropped with the 0x73 launch arm in the same commit. The alu-binary DECODE shape is deliberately UNTOUCHED: EHDecode's alu_binary XOR trap (exactly-one-of {IMM*, OPREF}) means an imm-form 0x73 still DECODES cleanly; the any-imm-present -> lower_required guard is EXECUTE-side (capability absence, never decode_error, never silent). OPREF-present discrimination: EHDecode packs dec_eff_opref_kind as {acc_any_opref, src_kind[2:0]} (presence bit 3 — without it a kind-0 direct-payload_b OPREF is indistinguishable from the imm form at the execute stage, since both read 4'h0); the PE_Core rung lowers when dec_eff_opref_kind[3]==0. The draft sub-op table is DELETED: an imm16 carve-out under the XOR invariant would be decode_error, so the invariant is honored instead of amended. Future imm-B/bf16-immediate loosening needs the per-opcode exemption machinery (0e-or-later).

opcodes.desc: FSCALAR — fp32 scalar A op B (B via F_HAS_OPB payload_b): sub-op imm16[7:4] per fscalar_op_codes (absent imm16 = FS_ADD); imm16[3:0] reserved-zero else lower_required; FS_FMA addend C = payload_a[63:32]; RNE-only, DAZ/FTZ; MU-hosted
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0c IMPLEMENTED (COMMIT F — MU-hosted FP_StepSeq step sequencer, spec §23.10.2). Monotonic loosening kept: imm16 forbidden->optional (absent=FS_ADD keeps every previously-legal encoding decoding). imm32/imm64 stay asm-forbidden but are RTL-tolerated (0x72 semantics verbatim — one forbid_imm_any bit, no per-size split; harmless because FSCALAR never reads eff_b_value: B arrives on the payload_b port, so forbid_opref stays true and rtl_alu_binary stays false, keeping the EHDecode alu-binary XOR trap dormant). Launch ladder: MU gate -> busy-reject (lower_required) -> imm16[3:0] reserved-zero / sub-op>0x4 lower_required -> missing payload_b error_flag (dispatch-side, §23.10.2) -> launch. IEEE specials always produce DATA, never error_flag.

opcodes.desc: fp32 rsqrt: LUT seed + 3 Newton iterations, <=2 ulp normative
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0c IMPLEMENTED (COMMIT F — MU-hosted FP_StepSeq step sequencer, spec §23.10.3: pinned range reduction, 256x9 seed ROM, 3 NR iterations, <=2 ulp + monotonicity normative, x=4^k bit-exact). Strictly port-only unary; launch ladder: MU gate -> busy-reject (lower_required) -> launch. IEEE specials always produce DATA, never error_flag.

v1.8.0c IMPLEMENTED (COMMIT F — MU-hosted FP_StepSeq step sequencer, spec §23.10.4: exact n+f split, degree-6 minimax Horner, integer bypass 2^n bit-exact, FTZ(RN_unbounded) underflow boundary, <=2 ulp + monotonicity normative). Strictly port-only unary; launch ladder: MU gate -> busy-reject (lower_required) -> launch. IEEE specials always produce DATA, never error_flag.

opcodes.desc: CVT — scalar f16/bf16 <-> f32 widen/narrow + I2F/F2I (dtype 0x4 = accumulator-format integer endpoint, pin 10): sub-op imm16[7:4] per cvt_op_codes (absent imm16 = WIDEN_TO_F32); imm16[3:0]/[15:8] reserved-zero and sub-op >0x1 lower_required; MU-hosted
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0d IMPLEMENTED (integration commit, spec section 23.10.10(b)): stub_v18 dropped with the 0x77 launch arm in the same commit. Launch ladder (0x74/0x75 mirror): MU gate -> busy-reject (lower_required) -> imm16[3:0]/[15:8] reserved-zero and sub-op > NARROW_FROM_F32 -> lower_required -> launch OPS_CVT (dtype_in = eff_precision[3:0]; F2I int results sext64 at the PE_Core result capture). Monotonic loosenings, both argued intent-preserving in the section 23.10.8 amendment: (1) legal_dtypes [2,3] -> [0,1,2,3,4] (illegal->legal only; dtype 0x4 names the int32/int64 endpoint, direction from sub-op; dtype 0x5 stays decode_error); (2) imm16 forbidden -> optional (0x72/0x74 precedent — CVT never reads eff_b_value, so imm16 is a sub-op selector, not a data channel; absent imm16 = WIDEN_TO_F32 keeps every previously-legal encoding decoding). imm32/imm64 stay asm-forbidden but RTL-tolerated (FSCALAR semantics verbatim — one forbid_imm_any bit, no per-size split; harmless because eff_b_value is never consumed, so forbid_opref stays true and rtl_alu_binary stays false, keeping the EHDecode alu-binary XOR trap dormant).

opcodes.desc: DEQUANT — int4/int8 lanes x fp32 broadcast scale -> bf16 (destination bf16-ONLY in 0e; dtype names the SOURCE per the conversion-dtype rule — no dest-dtype carrier exists and 0e adds none): int4 32-lane (128b, 2-frag A) -> 32 bf16 = 8 fragments; int8 16-lane -> 16 bf16 = 4 fragments; fp32 scale rides ext_payload_b on the wave-COMPLETING fragment beat; ROUND-ONCE RNE definition (a); MU-hosted
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0e 0e1 (spec section 25.2.2): stub_v18 dropped with the fused FP_StepSeq step program OPS_DEQ = 4'd9 (sequencer-side commit; the PE_Core lane-loop launch arm + deq_loop_active/fp_armed occupancy interlocks + loop-completion frag0_hold handoff land with the 0e1 integration commit). Port-only legality UNCHANGED (forbid_imm_any + forbid_opref stand — mandatory repair 4 closes the no-dest-dtype-carrier refutation by pinning dest bf16-ONLY; the 16-frag DEQUANT form is deleted by that pin). CLOSED-DEFERRED carriers (single future forbidden->optional imm16 loosening event, CVT precedent): slice-select = imm16[7:4], f32-dest = imm16[3:0] — this field map resolves the double-booking. Compute: exact I2F folded into an FS_MUL-shape tail through FP_Mul36 (|k| enters as an unnormalized significand; product <= 31 bits held exactly), then the bf16 ROUND-ONCE pack THROUGH the one shared narrow authority (RTO-24 intermediate -> include/fp_narrow_f32.vh; narrow(RTO24(v)) == RNE_bf16(v) for all v — pin-3 disjoint round/sticky, golden ref_dequant/micro_dequant twins). Specials pinned: scale denormal -> DAZ at operand load; scale NaN/Inf propagate through mul then narrow (k=0 vs Inf -> qNaN); k=0 or scale zero -> SIGNED zero, sign = sign(k) XOR sign(scale); product overflow -> +/-Inf never max-finite; product below bf16 min-normal -> FTZ signed zero at destination pack (proven vacuous for nonzero operands). Missing scale -> error_flag; launch-cycle capture of A(128b)+B(64b)+tag into MU-local regs (0x74 idiom). Measured OPS_DEQ start->done = 5 cycles/lane (spec estimate L=6-7, ceiling 8 — graduates estimate->measured at the C-gate TB). MU routing rides the twin-classifier lockstep edit (spec section 25.3) with the integration commit.

opcodes.desc: FMINMAX — vector frozen IEEE-2019 minimumNumber/maximumNumber, f32-only: 4 f32 lanes (128b = 2-fragment wave) vs ONE broadcast B (F_HAS_OPB payload_b port ONLY); sub-op imm16[7:4] per fminmax_op_codes (absent imm16 = MINIMUMNUM); imm16[3:0]/[15:8] reserved-zero else lower_required; the signed-int compare tree is NEVER reused for FP — dedicated offset-key comparator; MU-hosted; 128b out = 2 fragments
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0e 0e1 IMPLEMENTED (spec section 25.2.1). LEGALITY RE-ROW recorded (mandatory repair 3): the original pin (imm16 sub-op + OPREF-B required together) was UNDECODABLE under EHDecode's alu-binary XOR invariant — an encoding requiring imm AND OPREF simultaneously dies as alu_binary_xor_err, so no legal encoding existed in that shape. Re-rowed as an 0x74 FSCALAR legality clone verbatim: rtl_alu_binary true->false, forbid_opref->true, imm16 optional as CONTROL only (sub-op imm16[7:4]: 0x0=minimumNumber, 0x1=maximumNumber; [3:0]/[15:8] reserved-zero -> lower_required); B arrives on the dec_input_payload_b port ONLY, keeping the EHDecode alu-binary XOR trap dormant (the recorded 0x74/0x77 maneuver); missing-B -> error_flag (0x74 idiom); OPREF-B is a recorded post-0e loosening. SEMANTICS (frozen IEEE-2019, six pinned rows, section 23.10.8 pins carried unmodified): (1) -0 < +0 natively; (2) one NaN -> the number, bit pattern unchanged; (3) both NaN -> canonical qNaN 0x7FC00000; (4) sNaN quieted to canonical; (5) offset-transform total order via the dedicated comparator key a[31] ? ~a : (a ^ 0x80000000), ONE unsigned 32b compare per lane; (6) denormal cells BIT-PATTERN-PRESERVING, DAZ-EXEMPT (golden ref_fminmax operates on raw bit patterns, never decode()). Combinational PE_Core arm inside the MUL_OPS_SUPPORTED-gated dispatch (einsum-arm pattern), zero FP_StepSeq contact; 2-fragment output via the widened frag FSM. MU routing rides the twin-classifier lockstep edit (spec section 25.3) landing with the 0e1 integration commit. This re-row forces the frozen truth-table differential recapture + domain_version bump recorded in the same commit (section 25.6 item 7; 0x70-0x7F is outside the truth-table domain, so the visible recapture delta is the 0x6B reallocation).

opcodes.desc: FDOT32_CR — audit-only correctly-rounded 32-term narrow dot: r = pack_signed(exact sum of a_i*b_i) as fp32 (ONE unbounded RNE-24 + flush-after-round FTZ + overflow -> +/-Inf + exact-cancellation -> +0, PACK_FINAL semantics per spec section 27.7a.1); dtype names the WAVE dtype DIRECTLY (the conversion-dtype rule does NOT apply): 0x2 f16 / 0x3 bf16 x acc=1 x rnd=0 — EXACTLY 2 legal rows, every other combination ILLEGAL (restrictive-first); operands = A||B concatenated 16-fragment SINGLE wave (1,024b on dec_input_payload_wide: frag 0-7 = A's 32x16b, frag 8-15 = B's 32x16b, FRAG_MAX=16 exactly consumed); strictly port-only (no imm, no opref, no payload_b); result = 1 fp32 fragment, ACC bank untouched; MU-hosted
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0e 3a-C2 ISA ROW ONLY (spec section 27.7a; landing order 3a-C0 spec -> C1 golden -> C2 ISA (THIS) -> C3 step program -> C4 wiring + GATE V20-4). decode_reserved=true: 0x7A is DELIBERATELY omitted from the generated opcode_supported whitelist, so it still decode_errors exactly as the section 27.7 reservation wording says — whitelist entry lands with the PE_Core/EHDecode wiring at 3a-C4 (flip the bit, regenerate, commit both). This is decode_error (malformation), NOT a stub lower_required: no PE_Core arm exists yet and a decode-legal 0x7A without an arm would fall through the dispatch default — loud-fault-never-silent forbids that intermediate state, so decode_reserved and stub_v18 are mutually exclusive (generator-enforced). FROZEN TRUTH-TABLE UNTOUCHED (section 27.7a.4 finding): 0x70-0x7F is outside the truth-table domain — the 0x79 note's wording verbatim, "0x70-0x7F is outside the truth-table domain, so the visible recapture delta is the 0x6B reallocation" — hence this row forces NO differential recapture and NO domain_version bump (stays 3). LEGALITY: an 0x78 DEQUANT clone verbatim (forbid_imm_any + forbid_opref, rtl_alu_binary false keeps the EHDecode alu-binary XOR trap dormant); no sub-op nibble is burned and no F_HAS_OPB requirement exists — B rides the wide wave, not payload_b. OPERAND WAVE: the FIRST 16-fragment INPUT-wave reassembly consumer (0x70 VFMA_ACC int4 16-frag and the section 27.2.2 SPILL 8-frag are emit-side precedents); lane i reads A = payload[16*i +: 16] and B = payload[512 + 16*i +: 16] (the golden_fp32.lanes_to_frags packing pin, lane_bits=16); asm emits the wave via wave_fragments_fdot32_cr(). Launch-cycle MU-local capture (0x74 idiom — EHDecode is cluster-shared and cannot hold the buffer across a ~9k-cycle program); if 3a-C4 proves the 1,024b capture infeasible the pre-declared fallback is the 2-dispatch form (A-wave + B-wave, 0x70 interlock precedent) WITH a section 12a amendment. VALUE CONTRACT: bit-identical to the exact reference in scripts/acc_format_study.py (run_variants true (B) = pack_signed(exact)); golden twin = scripts/golden_fdotcr.py with include/generated/fdotcr_vectors.hex (450 directed lines) + fdotcr_golden_report.json (fixed seeds, byte-identical re-run; 57,022 value-contract trials, 0 mismatch). ALGORITHM (section 27.7a.2a, C1-amended): DESCENDING-magnitude RTO-48 fold over the completed non-overlapping expansion + the refined 'merge the two lowest' insertion walk; the original ascending fold pin was REFUTED by C1 measurement (2 value-contract counterexamples, 23.8% relative error), so an insertion-fused ascending streaming fold is the recorded regression path and is FORBIDDEN. SPECIALS (section 27.7a.1): bf16 exp field 0 (zero + all 254 subnormals) contributes canonical zero (DAZ, FP_FmaLaneBf16 S1 parity); f16 subnormals contribute EXACTLY (no DAZ); any NaN/Inf operand (sNaN included) yields canonical qNaN 0x7FC00000 plus a dedicated synthesizable sticky status bit (v1.9 bank_tag_collision_error class, never a sim-only assertion). AUDIT-ONLY: non-pipelined, busy-interlock (0x70 vfma_busy precedent), nested dispatch rejected; the ONLY throughput contract is cycle <= 10,000 (hard, GATE V20-4). ACC bank untouched — no state, no ownership, no drain interaction (the section 27.7a.4 regression-isolation argument). Purpose = the section 27.7a.3 invariant: a single-wave immediate-drain main-path result and an FDOT32_CR result over the SAME operands are BIT-EXACT, so a mismatch is a defect signal the SDK audit program raises loudly (program-level check; the hardware carries NO comparator).

opcodes.desc: STORE_QUANT — scalar int-dest requant: out=clamp_dtype(RNE(x>>s)), s=imm16[5:0] (absent=0, pure saturating clamp), x=signed int64 payload; dtype 0x0->[-8,7], 0x1->[-128,127]; 0x2/0x3 (f16/bf16) lower_required until v1.8.0d; emits sext64; L-PE hosted (no multipliers)
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0b IMPLEMENTED (scalar form). Monotonic loosenings: mem required->optional (present = offset IGNORED in 0b, RESERVED for the v1.8.0d memory-destination store form — asm warns), imm16 forbidden->optional. imm16[15:6] reserved-zero else lower_required. Never asserts memory_req in 0b.

opcodes.desc: accumulator spill/fill quarter-ops — frag FSM untouched; sub-op encoding v1.8.0b
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0a COMMIT 2 stub: decode-legal, PE_Core raises lower_required (capability absence, not malformation). Mode-byte legality per the normative spec §23.6a table — restrictive-first, later loosening only. v1.8.0b: stays stub — the "int32 spill loosening if needed" is affirmatively NOT needed (no accumulator exists); dtype row untouched.

opcodes.desc: FP_ACC_ZERO / FP_STATUS (sticky IEEE flags, atomic read-and-clear) — sub-op encoding v1.8.0b
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0a COMMIT 2 stub: decode-legal, PE_Core raises lower_required (capability absence, not malformation). Mode-byte legality per the normative spec §23.6a table — restrictive-first, later loosening only. v1.8.0b: stays stub — nothing to zero (no accumulator exists); ZERO/STATUS sub-op encoding decision defers WITH the op to v1.8.0c (do not burn the encoding space early).

fp_block._doc: 0x70-0x7F mode-byte legality — transcription of the NORMATIVE spec §23.6a table (COMMIT 0, independently reviewed). dtype=eff_precision[3:0], acc=[5:4], rnd=[7:6]; semantics active ONLY inside this block (in_fp_block self-gate). Global invariants (hand-pinned in tests, generator-independent): dtype 0x5 = f64/Lf-reserved illegal everywhere; dtype>0x7 illegal; rnd!=0 illegal in v1.8.0a (SR=1 is a v2.0 loosening at STORE_QUANT); acc!=1 illegal in v1.8.0a (bf16+acc0 permanently).
